run_boost_build_test: run a Boost Build test using the Tester class with a specified toolset and arguments
test_file_addition_removal: test that expected files are added or removed after running a build command
test_file_modification_touch: test that expected files are modified or touched after running a build command
test_build_output_content: test that the build system stdout/stderr output matches expected content lines
test_file_content_match: test that a generated file contains expected content with toolset suffix translation
